A [[Gender/Legends|male]] '''Sanyassan''' was a member of [[King/Legends|King]] [[Terak]]'s band of [[Sanyassan Marauders/Legends|Sanyassan Marauders]].

==Biography==
A clay-skinned [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Sanyassan/Legends|Sanyassan]], this individual belonged to the [[Sanyassan Marauders/Legends|Marauders]], a large group of [[Pirate/Legends|pirates]] who left their homeworld of [[Sanyassa IV]] and were stranded on the nearby [[Moon/Legends|moon]] of [[Endor/Legends|Endor]].<ref name="ISWU">''[[The Illustrated Star Wars Universe]]''</ref> He lived among his peers in the [[Terak's Keep|castle]] of Terak, self-proclaimed [[King/Legends|king]] of the Marauders.<ref name="BFE" />

Due to his [[Species/Legends|species]]' poor grasp on technology, this individual once poured [[Water/Legends|water]] over an electrical machine he was trying to "fix" with a [[Fork/Legends|fork]], which caused the device to burst into sparks.<ref name="BFE" />
